```{python}
#| label: fig-verification-fifo-hw
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "The hardware of `fifo.sv` with `DEPTH = 4`, with the registers in blue and the combinational logic in green. The storage `mem_q` has no reset. While `push` is high, a rising edge of `clk_i` stores `data_i` in the entry at the address `A`, the lower two bits of `wr_ptr_q`. The read multiplexer shows the entry at the lower two bits of `rd_ptr_q` at `data_o`, without a clock edge. Each pointer is a 3-bit register with the reset `rst_ni` and loads its value plus 1 while its enable `EN` is high. The RTL keeps a pointer with a multiplexer, which the figure draws as this enable, as Yosys maps it. The two comparators decode the flags from the pointers only: `empty_o` compares both pointers, and `full_o` compares `wr_ptr_q` with `rd_ptr_q` whose wrap bit is inverted. The two AND gates refuse a push into a full FIFO and a pop from an empty one."
#| fig-alt: "Block diagram. At the top, data_i enters the D input of the storage block mem_q, whose four entries 0 to 3 feed a 4:1 multiplexer that drives data_o. Below it on the left, push_i and the inverted full_o enter an AND gate, whose output push drives the EN input of the register wr_ptr_q and the EN input of the storage. On the right, pop_i and the inverted empty_o enter an AND gate, whose output pop drives the EN input of the register rd_ptr_q. Each pointer register returns its Q output through a +1 block to its D input and has the inputs clk_i and rst_ni. The lower two bits of wr_ptr_q drive the address A of the storage, and the lower two bits of rd_ptr_q drive the select of the multiplexer. At the bottom, the comparator on the left compares wr_ptr_q with rd_ptr_q with its wrap bit inverted and drives full_o, and the comparator on the right compares both pointers and drives empty_o. Both flags also return to the inverted inputs of the AND gates."
import schemdraw as sd
from schemdraw import flow, logic
from schemdraw import elements as elm
from schemdraw.elements import Element
from schemdraw.segments import SegmentPoly, SegmentText
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

BLUE, BLUE_L = '#6c8ebf', '#dae8fc'
GREEN, GREEN_L = '#82b366', '#d5e8d4'
GREY = '#666666'
XL, XR = -6.6, 7.6                         # pins of the FIFO
XS0, XS1, YS0, YS1 = -2.6, 0.8, 3.0, 5.4   # storage mem_q
ROWS = [YS1 - 0.3 - 0.6*k for k in range(4)]
YDAT = (YS0 + YS1)/2                       # data_i and data_o
XM = 1.6                                   # read multiplexer
XQW, XQR = -0.4, 1.95                      # pointer nodes, below the address pin and the select pin
XEN = -1.8                                 # write enable of the storage
YD, YEN, YCK = 0.0, -0.55, -1.55           # D, EN, and clock pins of the pointer registers
YLT, YP = 1.5, 2.3                         # feedback through +1, push to the storage
YX, YC, YB = -3.4, -4.5, -5.6              # write pointer to empty, comparators, read pointer to full
XCF, XCE = -4.6, 5.6                       # comparators
XFT, XET = -6.0, 7.0                       # full_o and empty_o back to the gates
RW, PIN, HEAD = 1.6, 0.7, 0.2              # width of a pointer register, length of a pin arrow and of its head
PAD, GAP, OFF = 0.15, 0.12, 0.38           # text inset from a box edge, gap to a pin arrow, offset from a wire


class Mux4(Element):
    ''' 4:1 multiplexer as a trapezoid, inputs 0 to 3 from the top, select at the bottom '''
    def __init__(self, w: float = 0.7, h: float = 2.6, s: float = 0.35, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        # zorder 3: polygons default below the filled boxes
        self.segments.append(SegmentPoly([(0, -h/2), (0, h/2), (w, h/2 - s), (w, -h/2 + s)], zorder=3))
        for k in range(4):
            self.segments.append(SegmentText((0.17, 0.9 - 0.6*k), str(k), fontsize=9, color='black'))
            self.anchors[f'in{k}'] = (0, 0.9 - 0.6*k)
        self.anchors['out'] = (w, 0)
        self.anchors['selbot'] = (w/2, -h/2 + s/2)
        self.params['theta'] = 0


def line(*pts):
    for a, b in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
        flow.Line().at(a).to(b)


def wire(*pts):
    ''' Lines through all points, with an arrow on the last segment '''
    line(*pts[:-1])
    flow.Arrow().at(pts[-2]).to(pts[-1])


def dot(p):
    elm.Dot(radius=0.06).at(p)


def text(p, s, halign='center', color='black'):
    ''' Text aligned to p in x, with its capitals centered on p in y '''
    # A free Label sits 0.1 to the right of its anchor with its baseline on it, so shift it back.
    # theta(0): a label inherits the direction of the last wire, and its alignment turns with it.
    elm.Label().theta(0).at((p[0] - 0.1, p[1] - 0.1)).label(s, color=color, halign=halign)


def clock(x, y, sign):
    ''' Clock triangle on a box edge at x, pointing into the box: sign +1 to the right, -1 to the left '''
    flow.Line().at((x, y + 0.2)).to((x + 0.3*sign, y)).color('black')
    flow.Line().at((x + 0.3*sign, y)).to((x, y - 0.2)).color('black')


def pointer(xq, name, sign):
    ''' Pointer register, inputs on the left (sign +1) or on the right (sign -1), Q at the node xq.
        Q returns through +1 over the top to D. Returns the EN pin and the x of the feedback lane. '''
    xo = xq - 0.5*sign
    xi = xo - RW*sign
    top, bot = YD + 0.85, YCK - 0.45
    flow.Box(w=RW, h=top - bot).at(((xi + xo)/2, (top + bot)/2)).anchor('center').fill(BLUE_L).color(BLUE)
    side, back = ('left', 'right') if sign > 0 else ('right', 'left')
    text(((xi + xo)/2, YD + 0.5), name)
    text((xi + PAD*sign, YD), 'D', halign=side)
    text((xi + PAD*sign, YEN), 'EN', halign=side)
    text((xo - PAD*sign, YD), 'Q', halign=back)
    clock(xi, YCK, sign)
    xl = xi - 0.8*sign
    xp = (xi + xo)/2
    line((xo, YD), (xq, YD), (xq, YLT), (xp + 0.4*sign, YLT))
    flow.Box(w=0.8, h=0.6).at((xp, YLT)).anchor('center').fill(GREEN_L).color(GREEN).label('+1', color='black')
    line((xp - 0.4*sign, YLT), (xl, YLT), (xl, YD))
    flow.Arrow().at((xl, YD)).to((xi, YD))
    dot((xq, YD))
    dot((xq, YLT))
    # clock and reset
    flow.Arrow().at((xi - PIN*sign, YCK)).to((xi, YCK))
    text((xi - (PIN + GAP)*sign, YCK), 'clk_i', halign=back)
    flow.Arrow().at((xp, bot - PIN)).to((xp, bot))
    text((xp, bot - PIN - 0.25), 'rst_ni')
    return (xi, YEN), xl


with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=1, fontsize=11, lw=1.5, bgcolor='white', margin=0.2)

    # storage without reset, written at wr_ptr_q[1:0] while push is high
    flow.Box(w=XS1 - XS0, h=YS1 - YS0).at(((XS0 + XS1)/2, YDAT)).anchor('center').fill(BLUE_L).color(BLUE)
    text(((XS0 + XS1)/2, YDAT), 'mem_q')
    text((XS0 + PAD, YDAT), 'D', halign='left')
    text((XEN, YS0 + PAD + 0.1), 'EN')
    text((XQW, YS0 + PAD + 0.1), 'A')
    clock(XS0, ROWS[3], 1)
    flow.Arrow().at((XS0 - PIN, ROWS[3])).to((XS0, ROWS[3]))
    text((XS0 - PIN - GAP, ROWS[3]), 'clk_i', halign='right')
    flow.Arrow().at((XL, YDAT)).to((XS0, YDAT))
    text((XL, YDAT + OFF), 'data_i', halign='left')

    # read multiplexer at rd_ptr_q[1:0]
    mux = Mux4().at((XM, YDAT)).fill(GREEN_L).color(GREEN)
    for k, y in enumerate(ROWS):
        text((XS1 - PAD, y), f'[{k}]', halign='right')
        flow.Arrow().at((XS1, y)).to((XM, y))
    flow.Arrow().at(mux.out).to((XR, YDAT))
    text((XR, YDAT + OFF), 'data_o', halign='right')

    # pointers, with the address of the storage and the select of the multiplexer
    en_w, xlw = pointer(XQW, 'wr_ptr_q', 1)
    en_r, xlr = pointer(XQR, 'rd_ptr_q', -1)
    flow.Arrow().at((XQW, YLT)).to((XQW, YS0))
    text((XQW + GAP, (YLT + YS0)/2), '[1:0]', halign='left')
    flow.Arrow().at((XQR, YLT)).to(mux.selbot)
    text((XQR - GAP, (YLT + YS0)/2), '[1:0]', halign='right')

    # push = push_i && !full_o, to the write pointer and the storage
    gw = logic.And(inputs=2, inputnots=[2]).right().scale(0.8).at((xlw - 0.9, YEN)).anchor('out').fill(GREEN_L)
    line((XL, gw.in1[1]), gw.in1)
    text((XL, gw.in1[1] + OFF), 'push_i', halign='left')
    xt = xlw - 0.4
    line(gw.out, (xt, YEN))
    dot((xt, YEN))
    flow.Arrow().at((xt, YEN)).to(en_w)
    text(((xt + en_w[0] - HEAD)/2, YEN - OFF), 'push')
    wire((xt, YEN), (xt, YP), (XEN, YP), (XEN, YS0))

    # pop = pop_i && !empty_o, to the read pointer
    gr = logic.And(inputs=2, inputnots=[1]).left().scale(0.8).at((xlr + 0.4, YEN)).anchor('out').fill(GREEN_L)
    line((XR, gr.in2[1]), gr.in2)
    text((XR, gr.in2[1] + OFF), 'pop_i', halign='right')
    flow.Arrow().at(gr.out).to(en_r)
    text(((gr.out[0] + en_r[0] + HEAD)/2, YEN - OFF), 'pop')

    # flags, decoded from the pointers only
    cf = flow.Box(w=1.2, h=0.7).at((XCF, YC)).anchor('center').fill(GREEN_L).color(GREEN).label('==', color='black')
    ce = flow.Box(w=1.2, h=0.7).at((XCE, YC)).anchor('center').fill(GREEN_L).color(GREEN).label('==', color='black')
    line((XQW, YD), (XQW, YC))
    flow.Arrow().at((XQW, YC)).to(cf.E)
    dot((XQW, YX))
    wire((XQW, YX), (XCE, YX), ce.N)
    line((XQR, YD), (XQR, YB))
    dot((XQR, YC))
    flow.Arrow().at((XQR, YC)).to(ce.W)
    wire((XQR, YB), (XCF, YB), cf.S)
    text((XCF + GAP, (YB + cf.S[1])/2), 'wrap bit inverted', halign='left', color=GREY)

    # full_o and empty_o leave the FIFO and gate push_i and pop_i
    flow.Arrow().at(cf.W).to((XL, YC))
    text((XL, YC - OFF), 'full_o', halign='left')
    dot((XFT, YC))
    line((XFT, YC), (XFT, gw.in2[1]), gw.in2)
    flow.Arrow().at(ce.E).to((XR, YC))
    text((XR, YC - OFF), 'empty_o', halign='right')
    dot((XET, YC))
    line((XET, YC), (XET, gr.in1[1]), gr.in1)
```
